Not the place if you have open loans or repos and they will run your information knowing you cannot get approved. I struggled with work after the shut down in October, which set me back in paying my car note followed by my car completely breaking down. Like most people, I fell behind on the note and decided to go for a new car altogether. I recently began working and am just a mother and wife trying to start over. I inquired about a vehicle in which Alex got back to me. I explained that I understand most companies deny for open auto loans but I have a decent amount to put down and would love to try them out. Rather than being HONEST they still ran my credit just to ask me about the open auto loan I have and denied me. I asked why did they run my information or not be honest when I told them prior? At the moment of me writing this post, it’s been 3 hours and still no response! Just want to save anyone from the hassle who may have a similar issue. Pretty taken back, that I was denied by a company that has numerous cars over 100k miles .

Had a good experience with them at first... My first car went out they made it right and got me into a second vehicle. But shortly after started having transmission issues. The dealership was informed of the issues with the transmission before the warranty expired and they knew I only had 1 vehicle but they needed to keep that car for almost a week to fix but I would have been out of work for a week as well. They stated get a second vehicle and we could fix the bad transmission. I couldnt afford another car but after a couple of weeks I was finally able to use a second vehicle and all of a sudden the issue was not covered under warranty any more and now I'm stuck with a car that won't move or start. They delayed and delayed until expiration. I have been a customer for almost 2 years and have never missed a payment but get treated this way is unfair and not professional. No issues with sales but major issue with maintenance department and a certain manager. 6 months ago I would have referred my own mother to this place but now that I see they care only to get you money but don't care about anything else when something goes wrong with your car I don't recommend my worst enemy to get a car from this establishment.
